name: Branch Push Tests

on:
  push:
    # Trigger on push to any branch except 'main' and tags (which are covered by release)
    branches-ignore: [ "main" ]
    tags-ignore: [ "**" ]

# Cancel any active, outdated runs on the same branch
concurrency:
  group: branch-test-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref_name }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  branch-verify:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ ubuntu-latest ]
        python-version: [ "3.14" ]

    uses: ./.github/workflows/template-test.yml
    with:
      os: ${{ matrix.os }}
      python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
